sources.title: DeBiasMe: De-biasing Human-AI Interactions with Metacognitive AIED (AI in Education) Interventions
sources.summary: While generative artificial intelligence (Gen AI) increasingly transforms academic environments, a critical gap exists in understanding and mitigating human biases in AI interactions, such as anchoring and confirmation bias. This position paper advocates for metacognitive AI literacy interventions to help university students critically engage with AI and address biases across the Human-AI interaction workflows. sources.summary: By defining the current limits (and thereby the frontiers), many boundaries are shaping, and will continue to shape, the future of Artificial Intelligence (AI). sources.title: Review on Control Strategies for Lower Limb Rehabilitation Exoskeletons
sources.summary: Research on lower limb exoskeleton (LLE) for rehabilitation have developed rapidly to meet the need of the population with neurologic injuries. LLEs for rehabilitation include therapeutic LLEs that aim to restore walking ability for patients, and assistive LLEs that offer support on activities in daily life. A substantial part of them can serve both purposes. However, these devices are yet to reach the final goal of performing human-machine joint movement agilely and smartly.
